game.title: Hitman 2
game.blurb: Stealth assassination game from IO Interactive, released 2018-11-13. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 863550)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/HITMAN_2
Fandom (hitman.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://hitman.fandom.com/wiki/Hitman_2_(2018_video_game)
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 863550 is not in the fetched Steam store app list (searching it for "HITMAN" finds the older Hitman games and "HITMAN World of Assassination", app 1659040, but no HITMAN 2), so HITMAN 2 looks delisted as a separate store product and its content is now most likely sold inside the HITMAN World of Assassination app; that last point was not confirmed from the data. The Steam Web API still answers for app 863550: the schema names it "HITMAN™ 2" and returns 146 achievements with percentages, so those were used. 39 of 146 are hidden; API names run ACH_0 to ACH_145 in list order and each mission's hidden ones sit inside that mission's block, so each hidden achievement was placed in the chapter of the block it sits in, by exact name ("Shhhh", 61.3%, sits among the general ones). "Security Defeated" (a guard moving a weapon into the hangar) names no mission but sits among The Final Test ones, so it was put with the prologue. The list also covers Paris, Sapienza, Marrakesh, Bangkok, Colorado and Hokkaido; RAWG says the game continues the plot of 2016's Hitman, so these look like that game's locations carried over, which needs checking. The "Sniper Assassin" mode name comes from RAWG's description and the Fandom link "HITMAN™ 2: Sniper Assassin". Locations come from the achievement text; "Milton-Fitzpatrick" (smuggling with an informant) sits in the New York block. StrategyWiki has "HITMAN 2" as a stub at completion stage 0; only its Table of Contents is written, and the many location and mission pages it links (for example "Hawke's Bay", "Nightcall", "Golden Handshake") are all missing, so nothing was used. The plain "Hitman 2" title on StrategyWiki is missing, and on hitman.fandom.com it is a short disambiguation page; "HITMAN 2" redirects to "Hitman 2 (2018 video game)", with about 89 linked articles, including a "HITMAN™ 2 Downloadable Content" category; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
